RUSSIAN RETREAT
EXCLUSIVE photographs of Kolchak's great retreat from UFA.

—At the very moment that ADMIRAI Kolchak expected the World-Wide recognition of his All Russian Provisional Government at Omsk, came the unexpected blow from the Bolsheviki, which resulted in his retreat from UFA. Pontons loaded with Kolchak War Material is here shown being transported over the UFA River, near the station Chacacha, in the hasty retreat.
